items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: And the fella would taught me he ought to play trombone. Old Charlie Clay, that man was great.

ctx.x: Roy Palmer. Yeah. I remember you mentioned to me.
Yeah, I like them fellas. And the fella would taught me he ought to play trombone. Old Charlie Clay, that man was great. He was great. He's passed on now.

You were mentioning to me one time about playing that pieces are all in the lower register, the trombone, like in the lower positions. Talk to me about that in our years. Can we say anything about that? Like in the sixth and seventh position?
